tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public products by query or explicit filters. queryMatch reports literal name/brand terms and whether the query phrase occurs in the name, not verified model identity; partial/none candidates remain visible and even a whole phrase can describe an accessory. Inspect product details and variant

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read a public product by UUID or slug, visible retailer offers with nullable seller/catalog condition (new, used, refurbished; null is unknown), and separate bounded merchant_feed_claims. Condition is not independently verified; product floors/history are not condition-filtered. Source evidence is u

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Read bounded daily effective-lowest USD history for a public product or one of its public offers. Uses existing last-observation-carried-forward aggregation, not condition-filtered history; a day is not a new seller price check.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Browse the public store directory, with declared origins, shipping coverage and store hub URLs. Offer counts are not a complete per-store product inventory.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: Read a public store hub and its bounded eligible product candidates. Keep category and store scope together. Product price floors are catalog-wide, not necessarily this seller's price; get_product provides the seller evidence.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Browse or literally search titles and summaries in the site's published guide index. Editorial advice is not a live price quote; read get_guide for the article and search products separately.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read publication-reviewed guide text, citations, disclosures and published continuations without paid matching or generation. Live product evidence is not included; follow catalogSearchUrl or use search_products/get_product.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List categories actually served by this storefront's public comparison catalog.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, list_stores · Public sink: get_price_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, list_stores · Public sink: get_price_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
